name: Wirtshaus Alt Seefeld
kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnis-Wirtshaus “Alt Seefeld” at Familotel Das Kaltschmid: Tyrolean flair, regional and international cuisine, open daily.
beschreibung: The Erlebnis-Wirtshaus “Alt Seefeld” is located in the centre of Seefeld in Tirol and belongs to Familotel Das Kaltschmid. It combines traditional Tyrolean flair with a cosy atmosphere. The kitchen serves regional and international specialities made from selected ingredients; vegetarian dishes are also on the menu. In winter, fruity mulled wine is brewed over an open fire, and at daily music and dance events guests can dance the night away. The restaurant is open daily from 09:00 to 02:00, with hot food from 11:00 to 23:00. Around 150 seats are available indoors and about 100 outdoors. Dogs are welcome.
